```
In `@weed/filer/empty_folder_cleanup/empty_folder_cleaner.go`:
- Around line 305-329: Update the empty-folder retention flow around countItems,
restoreFolders, and the efc.deleted cap so folders are not retained indefinitely
when counting or restoring repeatedly fails: apply DefaultRestoreCheckWindow (or
an existing bounded retry policy) to every failure and restore path before
re-adding entries, including folders selected for restore before counting.
Change the cap trimming after prepending keep so it removes the oldest retained
entries and preserves the newest deletions still within the restore window.

In `@weed/filer/filer.go`:
- Around line 376-381: Update Filer.DirectoryAttributes to check whether
FindEntry returned a nil entry after confirming there was no error, and return
filer_pb.ErrNotFound in that case before dereferencing entry. Preserve the
existing error return and attribute-building behavior for non-nil entries.
- Around line 382-388: Update the Mode assignment in the directory attributes
returned by the surrounding function to preserve setuid, setgid, and sticky bits
while excluding the directory type bit, matching the os.ModeDir handling already
performed by EnsureDirectoryEntry.

In `@weed/filer/redis3/kv_directory_children.go`:
- Around line 78-79: Update DeleteName so removal of the empty child and cleanup
of the parent header are retry-safe: make the mutations atomic, or ensure a
retry deletes the header when its referenced node is already missing. Preserve
normal deletion behavior while eliminating stale header references after a
failed client.Del.
```
